strings.privacy.title: Sirri
strings.privacy.description: Yadda pdffusion ke kula da fayilolinka: babu asusu, babu takardar da aka riƙe, babu talla kuma babu siyar da bayanai.
strings.privacy.intro: An gina pdffusion ne ta yadda takardunku za su kasance naku. Ga abin da ke faruwa lokacin da kuka yi amfani da shi, a sarari.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Fayilolinka
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ana aika su an kulle su (HTTPS), ana sarrafa su ta atomatik, sannan ana goge them da zaran sakamakon ya shirya. Manyan fayiloli suna zuwa ta wurin ajiyar ɗan lokaci a ƙarƙashin suna mai ratsawa kuma ana goge them da zaran sarrafawa ta ƙare; tsaftacewa ta atomatik tana cire duk abin da zai iya rage a cikin sa'o'i 24 mafi yawa.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Babu asusu, babu bayanan sirri
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion baya buƙatar rajista, babu adireshin imel kuma babu katin cire kuɗi. Ba a taɓa karanta takardunku, bincike, rabawa ko amfani da su don horar da basirar wucin gadi ba.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Auna masu ziyara
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Muna ƙidaya ziyara ba tare da bayyana suna ba kuma ba tare da kukis ba (Vercel Web Analytics) don sanin waɗanne kayan aiki ne ke da amfani. Babu talla, babu bin diddigin tsakanin shafuka.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kukis (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki guda ɗaya, na zaɓi: yana tuna harshen da kuka zaɓa.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Masauki (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Vercel ne ke karɓba rukunin yanar gizon a sabar da ke Paris; Render ke sarrafa juyawar Word, Excel da PowerPoint a Frankfurt. Waɗannan masu ba da sabar suna sarrafa fayiloli ne kawai don lokacin juyawa.

strings.legal.terms.title: Sharuddan amfani
strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion kyauta ne ga kowa, gami da 'yan kasuwa da gwamnatoci. Takardun ku na ku ne: babu abin da ake bincike ko adanawa.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Waɗannan sharuddan suna tafiyar da amfani da ku na pdffusion. An tsara su su zama gajeru kuma an rubuta su da sauƙin yare. Ta amfani da shafin, kuna karɓarsu.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Wanda ya wallafa pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: Mikailou Cedric Toure, mai tsara shirye-shirye a New Brunswick, Canada ne ya ƙira, gina kuma ya wallafa pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Lasisi kyauta na amfani, ga kowa
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdffusion kyauta ne, ba tare da rajista ba kuma ba tare da iyakacin lokaci ba, ga kowa: daidaikun mutane, ɗalibai, malamai, 'yan kasuwa, kungiyoyi masu zaman kansu, gwamnatoci, a Canada da kowace ƙasa. Babu amfanin da aka ware don tsarin biyan kuɗi, domin babu shi. Fayilolin da kuke samarwa naku ne gaba ɗaya: ba su da wata alama kuma ba su da ambaton pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Duk takardunku, har ma da waɗanda ke da sirri
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Kuna iya sarrafa kowane irin takarda, gami da waɗanda ke da sirri, saboda pdffusion baya karatu, bincike, adanawa ko raba fayilolin ku: ana sarrafa su ta atomatik sannan a goge su. Kuna kasancewa mai su, kuma ku ne ke da alhakin samun haƙƙin da ake buƙata don sarrafa su.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Lambar tushe da shigarwa akan sabar ku
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: An wallafa lambar tushe ta pdffusion ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT. Kuna iya karanta ta, bincika ta, shigar da ita akan sabar ku (har ma a kan cibiyar sadarwa ta rufe ba tare da Intanet ba), gyara ta kuma sake rarraba ta kyauta, idan dai kun kiyaye sanarwar haƙƙin mallaka da rubutun lasisi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Amfani da ya dace
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Ba za ku yi amfani da pdffusion don aikata laifi ba, ƙoƙarin katse sabis ɗin (lodawa ta atomatik mai yawa, ƙoƙarin shiga) ko ketare iyakokin fasaharsa ba. Girman da iyakokin adadin fayil suna kare sabis ɗin ga kowa.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Kasancewar sabis
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: Ana ba da pdffusion kyauta. Yana iya canzawa, a katse shi don gyara ko a dakatar da shi. Koyaushe kiyaye takardunku na asali: pdffusion baya adana kwafin su.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Garanti da alhaki
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Ana ba da sabis ɗin "kamar yadda yake", ba tare da wani garanti ba. Gwargwadon yadda doka ta ba da izini, mai wallafa ba ya da alhaki na lalacewar kai tsaye, asarar bayanai ko sakamakon juyawa mara kyau. Bincika takardun da kuka samar kafin amfani da su don wani abu mai mahimmanci.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Haƙƙin mallaka na fasaha
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Sunan pdffusion, tambarinsa da rubutun shafin na mai wallafa ne; lambar tana ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT kamar yadda aka ambata a sama. Alamomin kasuwanci da aka ambata (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) na masu su ne.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Dokar da ke sarrafawa
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Waɗannan sharuddan suna ƙarƙashin dokokin Lardin New Brunswick da dokokin tarayya na Canada masu aiki a cikinta. Kotunan New Brunswick suna da ikon yanke hukunci, ba tare da nuna wariya ga haƙƙin da dokar ƙasar ku ke ba ku a matsayin mai amfani ba.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Canje-canje
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Ana iya sabunta waɗannan sharuddan. Kwanan wata a saman shafin yana nuna sigar da ke aiki; canji yana aiki ne kawai ga amfani bayan an wallafa shi.

strings.legal.security.title: Tsaro da bayanai
strings.legal.security.description: Abin da ke faruwa ga fayilolin ku akan pdffusion: sarrafa ta atomatik, babu bincike, goge nan da nan, ɓoye bayanan sirri, karbar baƙi a Turai, da zaɓin shigar da shi akan sabar ku.
strings.legal.security.intro: Abin da ke faruwa ga fayilolin ku, inda ake sarrafa su da yadda ake kare su: an bayyana su da sauƙi, ga daidaikun mutane da sassan IT.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Babu takardun da ake adanawa
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Ana sarrafa fayilolin ku ta atomatik, sannan a goge them da zaran sakamako ya shirya ko an sauke shi. Babu kwafi, babu madadin ajiya kuma babu tarihin aiki. Tsabtace ta atomatik ta kowace rana kuma tana goge duk wani fayil na wucin gadi da zai iya kasancewa, nan da gobe da safe.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Babu bincike
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Babu wanda ke karanta takardunku. Ba a sanya su cikin jerin sunaye ba, ba a bincika su, ba a raba su ko amfani da su don horar da fasahar kere-kere. pdffusion ba shi da asusu, babu talla kuma ba shi da bayanan mai amfani.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Boyewar bayanai (Encryption)
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Ana ɓoye kowace alaƙa (HTTPS) kuma shafin yana tilasta ɓoye bayanai a kowane ziyara (HSTS). Kayan aikin Kare yana ɓoye PDF ɗinku da AES-256; kalmar sirrin da kuka zaɓa ba a taɓa adana ta ba.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Inda ake sarrafa fayilolin ku
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Shafi, PDF da kayan aikin hoto: Vercel, cibiyar bayanai ta Paris (Faransa, Tarayyar Turai). Juyawar Word, Excel da PowerPoint: Render, a Frankfurt (Jamus, Tarayyar Turai). Fayiloli sama da 4 MB: ajiyar Vercel Blob ta wucin gadi, a ƙarƙashin sunan bazuwar, an goge bayan amfani.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Kariya ta fasaha
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Kai tsaye tsaro (HSTS, hana shigar da shafin a cikin wasu shafuka, kariya daga rudani na nau'in fayil), adiresoshin fayil na wucin gadi waɗanda ba za a iya zato ba, da sabis na juyawa wanda ke karɓar buƙatun da ke dauke da sirrin alamar kawai. Ana bincika kowane sauyi na lamba ta atomatik (gwaje-gwaje, binciken nau'in) kafin ya tafi rayuwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Sirri da dokar da ke aiki
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: An wallafa pdffusion a New Brunswick kuma yana bin Dokar Kariyar Bayanan Keɓaɓɓu da Takardun Lantarki ta Canada (PIPEDA). Ba ya tattara bayanan keɓaɓɓu game da masu amfani da shi: babu asusu, babu adireshin imel, babu kuki na bin diddigi. An gina shi akan ka'idodi iri ɗaya da GDPR ta Turai da Dokar 25 ta Quebec: rage bayanai, babu sake amfani, goge bayan sarrafawa.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Ga ƙungiyoyi masu tsauri
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Idan dokokin ku sun haramta a Dake takardu zuwa sabis na waje, shigar da pdffusion akan sabar ku. Cikakken software kyauta ne, buɗaɗɗen tushe kuma yana aiki ba tare da haɗin Intanet ba: babu fayil ɗin da ke barin cibiyar sadarwar ku. Jagorar shigarwa tana kan shafin aikin.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Bayyana gaskiya
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Cikakken lambar tushe na jama'a ne: ƙungiyoyin tsaron ku za su iya tabbatar da kowace daga cikin waɗannan maganganun.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Ba da rahoton lahani
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Kuna tsammanin kun sami matsalar tsaro? Ba da rahoton ta a asirce daga shafin "Tsaro" na shafin aikin:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Samun dama
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Sanarwar samun dama ta pdffusion: WCAG 2.2 matakin AA manufa, matakan da aka ɗauka, sanannun iyakoki da yadda ake ba da rahoton matsala.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Kowa dole ne ya iya amfani da pdffusion, gami da mutanen da ba su gani ba ko masu raunin gani, kurame ko masu wahalar jin magana, ko masu nakasar motsi ko ta hankali.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Matsayin manufa
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: Manufar pdffusion ita ce ta dace da Jagororin Samun Dama na Abubuwan da ke cikin Yanar Gizo (WCAG) 2.2, matakin AA, ma'auni na duniya na W3C. Wannan matakin ya ƙunshi buƙatun Ma'auni na Gwamnatin Canada akan Samun Dama na Yanar Gizo, ma'auni na Turai EN 301 549 da Sashe na 508 a Amurka, waɗanda ke komawa zuwa WCAG 2.0 ko 2.1 matakin AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Matsayin dacewa
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion yana dace da wani ɓangare tare da WCAG 2.2 matakin AA: an lissafa sanannun iyakoki a ƙasa. Wannan sanarwar ta dogara ne akan kimantawa ta ciki da aka gudanar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 2026, ta amfani da kayan aiki na atomatik (axe, Lighthouse) da binciken hannu (keyboard, bambanci, zoom, sanarwa). Ba a gudanar da wani bincike mai cin gashin kansa ba tukuna.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Abin da ke wurin
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Dukkan shafin yana aiki da madannin buga rubutu (keyboard), tare da hanyar haɗi ta "Tsallake zuwa abun ciki" da kuma bayyanannen zane a kan abu mai aiki. Bambancin rubutu shine akalla 4.5:1. Ana sanar da matakan aiki (lodawa, sakamako, kuskure) ga masu karanta allo. Ana iya canza tsarin fayil ba tare da jan da saukewa ba, ta amfani da maɓallata. Shafin yana bi ഡirarin na'urarka na "rage motsi": sannan anarurrukan suna tsayawa gaba ɗaya. Shafuka suna ci gaba da kasancewa masu karatu a 400% zoom da kuma kan wayar hannu. An bayyana harshen kowane shafi, kuma ana nuna Larabci daga dama zuwa hagu.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Sanannun iyakoki
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Ba tare da wannan saitin ba, abubuwan motsi na ado (bango, zobe, alamar tsari) suna gudana ci gaba da guda; alamar tana tsayawa a kan shawagi da mai da hankali kan madannin buga rubutu. Ana sarrafa zoben motsi a shafin gida tare da linzamin kwamfuta ko yatsa; na ado ne, kuma jerin tsarin da yake nuna yana samuwa azaman rubutu a shafin. Harsunan da aka fassara ta na'ura na iya ƙunshi kurakurai. A ƙarshe, samun damar takarda da aka samar ya dogara ne akan asali: pdffusion baya ƙara alamun samun dama zuwa PDF wanda ba shi da shi.

strings.tools.fusionner.guide.uses[0]: Aika cikakken aikace-aikace (shaidar ɗan ƙasa, takardun shaida, fom) azaman fayil guda ɗaya, kamar yadda yawancin ofisoshin gwamnati ke buƙata.
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.uses[1]: Haɗa surori na kasida ko rahoto da aka rubuta a fayiloli daban-daban.
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.uses[2]: Juya hotunan waya na takardu zuwa PDF mai tsabta guda ɗaya.
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.steps[0].title: Ajiye fayilolin ku
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.steps[0].text: PDF, Word, Excel, hotuna… da yawa kamar yadda kuke buƙata.

strings.tools.fusionner.guide.steps[1].text: Ja su, ko amfani da kibiyoyi da tsarin A→Z.
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.steps[2].title: Danna Haɗa
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.steps[2].text: Kuna sauke PDF guda ɗaya tare da alamar shafi ɗaya kowane fayil.

strings.tools.fusionner.guide.faq[0].a: Eh. pdffusion yana sauya kowane fayil zuwa PDF ta atomatik kafin ya haɗa them, a cikin tsarin da kuka zaɓa.
strings.tools.fusionner.guide.faq[1].a: Har zuwa ɗaruruwan lokaci ɗaya, ba tare da alama ba kuma ba tare da rajista ba.

strings.tools.diviser.guide.faq[0].a: Eh: rubuta alal misali "1-3, 4-10" don samun fayil ɗaya tare da shafuka 1 zuwa 3 da wani tare da shafuka 4 zuwa 10.

strings.tools.diviser.guide.faq[1].a: Eh: zaɓi JPG ko PNG a ƙarƙashin "Tsarin sakamako".

strings.tools.renommer.options.ext.help: Canza tsawo baya canza tsarin fayil. Don canza fayil, yi amfani da Sauya.

strings.tools.renommer.guide.steps[2].text: Fayil ko tarihin ZIP yana saukewa.

strings.tools.ocr.tagline: Sanya rubutun takarda da aka binciko ko aka dauki hoto ya zamo mai bincike da kwafi.
strings.tools.ocr.seoTitle: OCR kyauta akan intanet: sanya PDF da aka binciko mai bincike
strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Karanta rubutun PDF da aka binciko ko hoto (OCR) domin ka bincika shi, ka kwafi shi ko ka sa a karanta shi babba. Harsuna 16, kyauta, ba a loda takardar ba.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Takardar da aka binciko ko aka dauki hoto hoto ce kawai: ba za ka iya binciken kalma ko kwafin jumla ba. Karanta hoton takarda yana gane kowane haruffa (wannan ana kiranta OCR) kuma yana ƙara ainihin rubutun zuwa takardar ba tare da canza yadda take gani ba. Karatu yana faruwa ne a kan na'urarka: ba a loda takardarka ba. Kawai samfurin harshen da aka zaɓa (ƴan MB) ana saukar da shi sau ɗaya.

strings.tools.redimensionner.seoTitle: Canza girma da yanke hotuna akan intanet kyauta
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: Rage hoto (ta % ko a pixels) ko yanke shi zuwa murabba'i, 16:9 ko 4:3, sannan a adana shi azaman JPG, PNG ko WebP. Kyauta, babu rajista.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Saka hotunanka, zaɓi don rage su ko yanke su, duba samfoti, sannan danna Canza girma / yanke. Yana da amfani ga hoton bayanin martaba, haɗe-haɗe mai nauyi ko fom wanda ke buƙatar takamaiman girma.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.mode.label: Me za a yi?
Riƙe dukan hoto, ya zama ƙarami.
Yanke gefuna don samun daidaitaccen tsari.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.scale.label: Sabon girma
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.width.label: Faɗi (pixels)
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.height.help: 0 = an lissafa shi don riƙe ma'auni.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.ratio.label: Tsari
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.keywords: canza girman hoto, rage girman hoto, yanke hoto akan intanet, gyara girman hoto, sanya hoto ya zama ƙarami, hoto murabba'i
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[0]: Rage hoto mai nauyi don imel ko fom din intanet.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[1]: Yanke hoto zuwa murabba'i don bayanin martaba.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[2]: Shirya hotunan 16:9 don gabatarwa ko gidan yanar gizo.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[1].text: Samfotin yana nuna yankin da aka riƙe da sabon girman.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[2].text: Kana saukar da hotunan da aka gyara.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].a: Hoto mai ƙarami yana da ƙananan pixels amma yana zama mai kaifi a sabon girmansa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].a: A tsakiyar hoton: ana yanke gefuna daidai gwargwado don isa ga zaɓaɓɓen tsari, kamar yadda samfotin ke nuna.
